description: The Samsung Galaxy A27 is going to launch in India soon. The handset from the brand comes equipped with a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED Full HD+ display. The smartphone is powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 processor and offers up to 8GB of RAM and up to 256GB of internal storage. The device is loaded with a triple-camera setup on the rear panel. Check out the first impressions to know more about the Samsung Galaxy A27 5G.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G First Impressions

description: WhatsApp has begun rolling out username reservations ahead of the wider launch of usernames later this year. The feature will let users connect without sharing their phone numbers and includes privacy measures such as an optional username key for first-time contacts. WhatsApp says there will be no public username directory or suggestions. The company has also introduced a username generator and will let creators, businesses, and organisations claim their existing Instagram or Facebook usernames for a consistent identity across Meta platforms.
title: WhatsApp Now Lets You Reserve Your Username Before the Much-Anticipated Feature Goes Live

description: Huawei is rumoured to launch the Huawei Mate 90 series in September this year. The company is said to skip launching the Mate 90 lineup alongside its next foldable. Last year, the company launched its Mate series and foldables in a single launch event. The September launch window would mark a significant shift from Huawei's previous release schedule of the Huawei Mate series.  Additionally, the Huawei Pura 90S series has reportedly been scrapped.
title: Huawei Mate 90 Series Launch Timeline Revealed in New Leak; Mate XT 2 May Arrive Separately

description: Kingdom Come Deliverance 2 has sold six million copies, Warhorse Studios has confirmed. The RPG launched on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on February 4, 2025. KCD 2 has also received a 60 percent discount on Steam during the ongoing Summer Sale.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Has Sold 6 Million Copies, Warhorse Studios Confirms

description: Loopring has shut down its decentralised exchange and automated market maker after citing weak adoption, limited business development, and increasing competition from newer zkEVM solutions. The Ethereum scaling pioneer, which launched one of the first zk-rollup implementations, said it will distribute users’ remaining balances to their Ethereum addresses. The closure adds to a growing list of crypto projects winding down operations in 2026 amid changing market conditions.
title: Loopring Shuts Down Decentralised Exchange, Halts Trading Operations

description: Sony Bravia 9 II and Sony Bravia 7 II 4K RGB LED TV lineups were launched in India. The former comes in two display options, while the latter is available in four screen sizes. They are launched with a starting price tag of Rs. 3,59,900 and go up to Rs. 9,89,900. They have a 120Hz refresh rate and run on Sony's XR Processor.
title: Sony Bravia 9 II, Bravia 7 II 4K RGB LED TVs Launched in India With XR Processor: Price, Features

description: Xiaomi has hosted a Wireless Power Consortium meeting in Beijing to advance the upcoming Qi 50W wireless charging standard, according to a recent report. Apple, Google, Huawei, Oppo, Vivo, and several other companies participated in discussions, prototype testing, and interoperability verification. The report says the standard is expected to launch in 2028 after further development. Xiaomi is also promoting a small inductance, low voltage, and high power charging architecture that has already entered the Qi 50W standard drafting process.
title: Xiaomi, Apple, Google Reportedly Join Hands to Advance Qi 50W Wireless Charging Standard

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G has been launched in India. The new Galaxy M series handset is set to go on sale in India on July 4 via Amazon. The smartphone is offered in two colour options, namely Blaze Blue and Rogue Red. The Samsung Galaxy M47 5G is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. The handset is also equipped with a 6,000mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging. The handset carries a triple rear camera unit, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 have gone on open sale in India through the company's official channels and partner retailers. The earbuds are currently available at an introductory price of Rs. 3,099 for a limited period, down from the listed price of Rs. 3,299. They feature 12mm titanium-coated dynamic drivers, up to 52dB active noise cancellation, Bluetooth 6.1, AI-backed calling features, and support up to 54 hours of claimed battery life when paired with the charging case.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 With Up to 54-Hour Battery Life Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Binance recorded more than $400 million in weekly net outflows after withdrawing its Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) licence application in Greece ahead of the European Union’s July 1 deadline. Despite the outflows, the amount represents only a small fraction of the exchange’s total assets. Binance has said it remains committed to securing MiCA authorisation in another EU member state while preparing users for changes to services within the region.
title: Binance Records Over $400 Million Weekly Net Outflows Ahead of EU MiCA Deadline

description: The Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro comes loaded with interesting features and benefits. The earbuds feature 12.4mm drivers for good sound output. The earbuds also support active noise cancellation up to 40 dB of noise reduction. It has an IP55 rating, making it dust- and splash-resistant. It also comes with up to 56 hours of battery life with the case, while the earbuds deliver up to 8 hours of backup without ANC. The charging is as fast as well, and you get 2 hours of music playback with 10 minutes of quick charge.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro Review: Pure Value, No Compromises

description: With the second half of 2026 approaching, Apple’s next-generation iPhone lineup is gradually coming into focus. The rumour mill has indicated a split launch of the iPhone 18 series, with the Pro models debuting this year, while the vanilla iPhone 18 is expected in 2027. Ahead of their expected debut, a new leak has shed light on the display specifications of the purported handsets. The tipster also claims that Apple's 2027 flagship models, including the iPhone 19 Pro lineup and second-generation foldable iPhone, have already entered an early stage of development.
title: iPhone 18, iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 Display Specifications Leaked; iPhone 19 Pro Said to Enter Testing

description: Nothing has confirmed that the upcoming Phone 4b will be powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon chipset ahead of its July 7 launch. While the company has not revealed the exact chipset, it says the platform will deliver improved performance, better power efficiency, and support for on-device artificial intelligence features. Recent leaks suggest the smartphone could use the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset, alongside a 6.7-inch 120Hz AMOLED display, a 5,400mAh battery, and a 50-megapixel primary camera.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Confirmed to Feature Snapdragon Processor A Week Ahead of Debut

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 will be launched with support for faster wired charging than its predecessor, a tipster claims. The clamshell-style foldable is said to launch with support for 45W wired fast charging. For reference, the Galaxy Z Flip 7, which was launched in July 2025, supports 25W (wired) and 15W (wireless) fast charging. The handset is equipped with a 4,300mAh battery. On the other hand, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 might arrive with 5,000mAh and 4,800mAh batteries, respectively, while offering the same charging support as the Galaxy Z Flip 8.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Tipped to Support Fast Charging, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Might Arrive With a Larger Battery

description: Sony’s next-generation PlayStation console could be significantly more expensive for the manufacturer. Information shared by a known hardware tipster suggests that the bill of materials (BoM) for the PS6 was previously estimated to be about $760 (roughly Rs. 72,000). But as AI data centres continue to consume high-performance memory, soaring prices of DRAM and memory components are said to have driven the cost to around $960 (roughly Rs. 91,000).
title: PS6 Tipped to Cost Nearly $1,000 to Manufacture as Memory Prices Continue to Rise

description: Bitcoin hovered around $60,000 on Monday as investors remained cautious amid renewed Middle East tensions and continued weakness in institutional demand. Analysts said persistent spot Bitcoin ETF outflows, macroeconomic uncertainty, and expectations of higher US interest rates kept risk appetite subdued, although historical trends suggest Bitcoin has typically performed well in July.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $60,000 as Geopolitical Tensions Keep Crypto Investors on Edge

description: The Vivo X500 series will reportedly include four models. The lineup could feature the standard Vivo X500, Vivo X500e, Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max models spanning across different price segments. The  Vivo X500 Pro Max is said to feature a 6.85-inch LTPO display with 2K resolution. The BOE-made 2.5D flat display is tipped to feature thin bezels and rounded corners. It is said to feature LPDDR6 RAM and could run on MediaTek's upcoming Dimensity 9600 chipset.
title: Vivo X500 Series Tipped to Feature Four Models; Vivo X500 Pro Max Said to Feature LPDDR6 RAM

description: Red Magic has confirmed that the upcoming Gaming Tablet 5 Pro will launch globally as the Red Magic Astra 2. The announcement comes ahead of the tablet's June 30 debut in China, where several specifications have already been confirmed. The gaming tablet will feature a 9.06-inch OLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate, RGB Liquid Cooling, and a redesigned gaming-focused chassis. It is also expected to arrive with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, although the processor has not been officially confirmed.
title: Red Magic Astra 2 Confirmed to Debut as Global Variant of Upcoming Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro

description: Sony plans to continue backing live service games, PlayStation CEO Hideaki Nishino has said in an interview. Despite mutliple live service games being cancelled, the company plans to release more multplayer titles. Nishino said that live service games were "important for continuously providing something."
title: Sony Plans to Continue Releasing Live Service Games Despite Setbacks

description: Apple will refresh the Mac Studio desktop with the M5 Ultra chipset this year, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter Power On. Moreover, the Tim Cook-led company also plans to refresh the workstation with the rumoured M7 Ultra chipset in 2028. However, the company has yet to confirm these details. Apple is reportedly also planning various internal changes for the Mac Studio. The tech giant could equip the desktop with an enhanced heat sink for improved thermal management, preparing for more resource-intensive on-device AI workloads. However, Apple might not make any external design changes, following earlier trends.
title: Mac Studio With M5 Ultra Chip Said to Be in Development; Launch Timeline for M7 Ultra Version Also Leaked

description: Amazon on Monday revealed the first wave of deals ahead of Prime Day 2026 in India. The e-commerce giant’s annual sale begins next month and is scheduled to run from July 4 through July 6. The three-day shopping event will offer discounts across smartphones, consumer electronics, home appliances, TVs, laptops, audio products, and Amazon-branded devices. Amazon says Prime members will have access to more than 500 new product launches, alongside bank offers, exchange discounts, no-cost EMI options, and cashback benefits.
title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Deals Revealed: Smartphones, TVs, Laptops and More to Get Discounts

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition is now available for purchase in India through Flipkart and other retail channels. The new smartphone, designed in collaboration with Italian design house Pininfarina, features a carbon-fibre-inspired finish and an aerospace-grade aluminium frame. It runs on a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. It features a 6,500mAh battery with 90W wired fast charging support.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers, Features

description: Vivo TWS 5 Pro earphones launched in China with an 11mm dynamic driver unit and spatial audio support. They have Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity and can be paired with three devices simultaneously. The earphones offer a minimum latency of 42ms for gaming and include a Hi-Fi DAC chip with 113db dynamic range. The Vivo TWS 5 Pro has an IP54-rated build for dust and water resistance. The earbud houses a 56mAh battery, while the charging case has a 615mAh battery.
title: Vivo TWS 5 Pro Launched With Built-In Hi-Fi DAC, Up to 50 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Moto Pad 70 Pro has been launched in India. The new flagship tablet from the tech firm is set to go on sale in the country on July 4 via Flipkart and the Motorola India online store. The Moto Pad 70 Pro is offered in a single Pantone Titan colourway. It ships with Android 16-based Hello UI. The Moto Pad 70 Pro is equipped with a 13-inch 3.5K (3,504 x 2,190 pixels) LCD touchscreen, offering up to 144Hz refresh rate, up to 800 nits peak brightness, 319 ppi pixel density, Dolby Vision, and Moto Pen Pro support. Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset powers the Moto Pad 70 Pro.
title: Moto Pad 70 Pro Launched in India With 10,200mAh Battery, 13-Inch 3.5K Display: Price, Specifications

description: Rockstar reportedly has no plans tor release a disc version of Grand Theft Auto 6 — not at launch and not months after. That's according to a report from The Hollywood Reporter, citing a source familiar with the studio's plans. GTA 6 is only launching digitally in November; the physical version does not include discs and only comes with a download code inside the box.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Reportedly Not Get a Disc Version After November Launch

description: The Xiaomi 18 series has been in the rumour mill for quite some time. While its debut is anticipated for later this year, key specifications of the company’s next-generation flagship lineup have surfaced in recent months. A tipster has now shared details about the battery on the standard Xiaomi 18. Its engineering prototype is said to feature a modestly larger cell compared to the existing Xiaomi 17, which is equipped with a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Xiaomi 18 Tipped to Feature 7,200mAh Battery Despite Its Compact Form Factor

description: Samsung is reportedly accelerating development of its first commercial rollable smartphone. The handset is said to target a launch in the first half of 2028 and may feature an expandable 10-inch display. It is also rumoured to debut as the Galaxy Z Slide, with another rollable model reportedly planned for 2030. Samsung has yet to confirm the device, but has previously showcased several rollable and hybrid display concepts.
title: Samsung Reportedly Developing Rollable Phone With Expandable 10-Inch Display

description: The iPhone 18 series is expected to be launched in September. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to announce a launch date for its next-generation flagship smartphones, a seasoned journalist believes they could debut in the second week of September. Separately, a new prediction from a market research firm suggests the upcoming Pro models could become significantly more expensive than their predecessors, in line with Apple’s recent price hikes.
title: iPhone 18 Series Launch Date Reportedly Surfaces as IDC Predicts Major Price Increase

description: iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone 17 Pro Max will be available at discounted prices during the upcoming Flipkart GOAT Sale, the e-commerce platform has revealed. Apart from this, the iPhone Air, iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, iPhone 17e, iPhone 16e, and iPhone 15 will also be listed at relatively low prices. The Flipkart GOAT Sale 2026 is set to begin on July 4. The company will offer 24 hours of early access to Flipkart Black and Flipkart Plus members. Moreover, Flipkart GOAT Sale 2026 will offer an instant discount of 10 percent to customers with credit cards of select banks.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air and More to Go on Sale at Discounted Prices During the Upcoming Flipkart Sale

description: OnePlus may expand 185Hz refresh rate displays beyond its flagship smartphones, according to a new leak. The tipster claims the company plans to introduce the technology across both flagship and sub-series devices. If that strategy extends to future models, the OnePlus 16R and Nord 7 could also adopt 185Hz panels. Earlier leaks have already tipped the OnePlus 16 to feature a 185Hz BOE display alongside the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset.
title: OnePlus to Bring 185Hz Displays to OnePlus 16R, OnePlus Nord 7 and Additional Models, Tipster Claims

description: Apple's smart glasses are expected to take more time than expected. In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman claimed that the launch its first smart glasses by the end of next year, indicating a later launch timeline than earlier expectations. This delay could help Meta to gain more market share. Apple's first smart glasses will offer tighter integration with the iPhone, and the ecosystem integration is likely to make it more difficult for Meta to attract Apple's large user base.
title: Apple Smart Glasses Said to Launch by End of 2027 as Rival to Meta's Smart Glasses

description: Apple has been rumoured to rethink its iPhone launch strategy by introducing only the Pro models in September, while the standard variant is reserved for March next year. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to confirm such plans, an analyst has suggested that the base iPhone 18 and the non-flagship iPhone 18e could ship with 9GB of RAM, which is a modest upgrade over the current iPhone 17 and iPhone 17e. The additional memory is said to help the devices handle Apple Intelligence features more smoothly under iOS 27.
title: iPhone 18, iPhone 18e to Feature 9GB of RAM to Better Handle Apple Intelligence: Kuo
